name: web_search
description: Search the web and return relevant pages with snippets. Use for current facts, regulations, rates and anything not covered by a more specific tool.

name: calculator
description: Evaluate an arithmetic expression, e.g. loan payments, percentages or straight-line depreciation of any amount over any number of years.

name: restaurant_booking
description: Find and reserve restaurant tables by cuisine, location, date, time and party size.
